### Background

Pipeline eval fixture (task 0595) — a deliberately minimal implement task whose only
purpose is to exercise every pipeline state end to end: precheck → implement →
test → review → verify → record → done. Generated by
`scripts/spur-dev.ts eval-pipeline`; never edited by hand.

### Requirements

- R1 — The file `tests/fixtures/pipeline-eval/scratch/{{WBS}}.md` exists after
  implementation and contains exactly the line `fixture {{WBS}} ok`.

### Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Feature: pipeline eval fixture {{WBS}}

  Scenario: R1 — scratch file written
    Given the implement stage has run
    When tests/fixtures/pipeline-eval/scratch/{{WBS}}.md is read
    Then it contains exactly the line "fixture {{WBS}} ok"
```

### Q&A

- Fixture task shape — standard `task` template, 1 R-item, 2 Plan items: small
  enough to pass the size precheck (max 5 reqs / 8 plan items) on a standard-tier
  executor.

### Design

Single scratch-file write under the declared path. No source, config, or corpus
changes. The backticked path above is the implement scope guard's allowlist.
